description: Convert the project from TypeScript (.tsx/.ts files) to plain JavaScript with JSX (.jsx/.js files). Remove all TypeScript type annotations, interfaces, and type imports. Replace tsconfig.json with jsconfig.json for path aliases. Update package.json to remove TypeScript-related dependencies. Update jest config to work with plain JS.
steps: Rename all .tsx files to .jsx and all .ts files to .js (except config files that need to stay as-is)
Remove all TypeScript type annotations, interfaces, and type imports from the code
Remove tsconfig.json and create jsconfig.json with @/ path alias
Update package.json to remove typescript, @types/*, and ts-jest dependencies
Convert jest.config.ts to jest.config.js and update to work without ts-jest
acceptance_criteria: No .ts or .tsx files remain in the src/ directory
No TypeScript type annotations remain in the code
verification: Run npm run build in /projects/sandbox/Brainstrom and confirm exit code 0
Run npm test in /projects/sandbox/Brainstrom and confirm all tests pass
